rv.q: All of it amounts to a lot less than the sum of its parts: a laboured production of a laboured adaptation.
This is a great pity because somewhere in this hall of mirrors is an absorbing 75 minute play.

cn.t: Barr's memoir struggles in its transition to stage, with critics finding the adaptation overlong and lacking the intimacy of the source material, though some praise its brave exploration of timeless themes.
